outcome: Severe lesions on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
cohort: 70 very low birth weight infants with a mean birth weight of 1226 g.
finding: Abnormal early amplitude-integrated EEG background is significantly associated with severe brain lesions detected by MRI and US in very low birth weight infants.
followup_time: Up to the neonatal period (first 28 days of life)
